facts.value: Graduates who receive a bachelor's degree in Jewish studies and pursue a career with one of the hundreds of U.S. companies that do business in Israel have a competitive edge because of their familiarity with Jewish culture. Jewish studies graduates are also prepared to attend rabbinical seminary in preparation for becoming a community rabbi or chaplain, engage in world political and economic issues, and pursue advanced education in Jewish professional service fields.
